content: Dhruv Kapoor called to follow up on his auto policy that expired on March 8th. He considered reinstating the old policy (which would incur a $50 fee and a $170 penalty) but is also open to new options. After reviewing the emailed proposals, he is leaning toward the option with a 5% discount and asked Sunita Agarwal for more details on coverage and deductibles.

action_items: Sunita to provide detailed coverage and deductible information for the 5% discount option
Dhruv to decide on reinstatement versus the new policy after receiving details
